candidates.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Calf Raise
Novice
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in each hand, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
2
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
Beginner
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
2
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
3
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
Novice
1
Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
2
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
3
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
Novice
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
2
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double
Novice
1
Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
2
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
3
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
Novice
1
Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
2
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
Beginner
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
2
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
3
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
